title: Rays beat Guardians again, return home one win from World Series berth

 Rays beat Guardians again, return home one win from World Series berth
 Drew Rasmussen works seven dominant innings as Tampa Bay wins Game 5 of the ALCS. “It all ends (Monday),” DH Yandy Diaz says afterward.     .   Rays starter Drew Rasmussen celebrates the end of the seventh inning Sunday in Game 5. He worked seven dominant innings, limiting the Guardians to one run on four hits and a walk while striking out six. [ DAVID J. PHILLIP | AP ] Marc Topkin is a sports reporter covering the Tampa Bay Rays. Reach him at mtopkin@tampabay.com.
